-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check. Verifies Context7 API key presence and connectivity.

resolve-library.name: resolve-library
resolve-library.description: Resolve a Context7 library identifier from a free-text name (e.g. "react" → "/reactjs/react.dev"). Returns ranked candidates with reputation and snippet count. Cache: 7d. Use the chosen `id` as `libraryId` for `get-docs`.

get-docs.name: get-docs
get-docs.description: Fetch up-to-date documentation snippets for a Context7-resolved libraryId. Returns array of {title, source, description, code, language}. Use `resolve-library` first to get the libraryId.

params.libraryId: Context7-compatible library id (e.g. "/reactjs/react.dev"). Get it from `resolve-library`.

name: Context7
description: Up-to-date library and framework documentation via Context7 (Upstash). Resolves library identifiers and fetches structured doc snippets with code examples.

changelog.notes: Initial release — find software libraries by name and fetch up-to-date documentation snippets with real code examples
